envelope.description: Cross-cutting tests (re-validate preservation + integration + code feedback)

body.title: Cross-cutting tests (re-validate preservation + integration + code feedback)
body.summary: Add the cross-cutting tests: mergeWithPrior/persistBuildRecord preserve a prior changeLog + out-of-band appended feedback across a re-validate (append-only); an integration append→read→render of BUILD code feedback via s1 appendFeedback with a source-file target; a legacy BUILD record (no changeLog/feedback) re-renders byte-identically. Confirm ac1-ac4 mapped + full sweep green (tsc clean).
acceptanceChecks: BUILD code feedback appends via appendFeedback and renders; legacy record byte-identical; ac1-ac4 each have ≥1 passing test; full sweep green

tests.name: persistBuildRecord/mergeWithPrior: a re-validate that omits changeLog keeps the prior changeLog; a prior out-of-band feedback entry survives; a new write's recomputed changeLog replaces the prior
appendFeedback on the BUILD json with a source-file ProvenanceTarget → an append-only, attributed code-feedback entry on body.feedback that renders in the Feedback section (ac2)
a legacy BUILD record (no changeLog/feedback) reads + re-renders byte-identically (ac4)
